text:
sasha: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — streaming/chat endpoint started returning partial responses and forced reconnects last night. Need owners + timelines for remediation.

incident-bot: Incident INF-842 created by sasha at 2026-03-22T21:20:15Z. Severity: P2. Checklist created.

emily: root cause recap: seen repeated KV-cache evictions on worker pool during high-concurrency windows + a GC spike on worker-3. When eviction and GC overlapped, response loop timed out and client saw partial streams. Logs: see snippet.

emily: ```
2026-03-22T21:14:03Z worker-3 ERROR kv_cache_eviction evicted=125 time_ms=1120
2026-03-22T21:14:04Z worker-3 WARN reconnect attempt=1 reason=stream_timeout duration=30s
```

raj: Proposed action items: 1) make reconnect logic exponential backoff + jitter (so clients don't thrash), 2) add worker-side streaming timeout guard + circuit breaker, 3) add a synthetic streaming test to catch regressions.

kevin: I can own reconnect logic changes (server+client libs). Will add jitter + cap at 60s and immediate 0.5s initial backoff. Plan: branch -> canary -> prod. ETA: 2026-03-29. @sasha assigning to kevin.

olivia: I'll own alerting + dashboard work: 1) new metric stream_partial_percent, 2) graph KV eviction latency, 3) alert when partials > 0.5% for 5m. ETA: 2026-03-26.

matt: I'll own the regression harness — add a nightly streaming test that runs at 50 concurrent clients for 1h and validates continuity + reconnect behavior. Also add into release checklist. ETA: 2026-04-05.

sasha: Good. Please add JIRA links to INF-842 and update the postmortem doc (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-842). We also need a short runbook for on-call: what to do when partial responses spike.

kevin: quick note on implementation: server change needs safe feature flag. Client libs need minor API bump (opt-in reconnect jitter). I'll open PRs today.

raj: Also recommend lowering default streaming socket keepalive to 20s for a trial window, and add a guard in the load-balancer to avoid ejecting healthy instances during GC.

olivia: I'll create alerts and a dashboard draft and post in #eng-sre for review.

kevin: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infer/PR/4592 - basic reconnect + jitter, unit tests included. Marking as draft until canary run.

matt: Created regression job in CI: nightly/streaming-continuity. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/nightly-streaming-contin. Kicking off first run now.

incident-bot: Action items created in INF-842: KEVIN-impl-reconnect, OLIVIA-alerts-dashboard, MATT-reg-harness. Due dates set per owners.

sasha: Action owners — please update INF-842 when you hit each milestone. We'll reconvene next Tue 11am for status. If anyone can't meet ETA, ping now. :eyes:

kevin: ack. I'll post canary metrics in this thread when available. :thumbsup:

olivia: ack. Posting dashboard link when draft ready.

matt: ack. If regression shows failures I'll quarantine the flaky model variants and post rollback steps.

sasha: Thanks all. Closing this thread for now but we'll use it for status updates.
